title: Al-Balad 90:15-20 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Fajr and the families of madd
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 23 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Balad 90:15-20 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 23. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ (١٥) أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ (١٦) ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ (١٧) أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ (١٨) وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ (١٩) عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ (٢٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Or a needy person in misery
And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
Those are the companions of the right.
But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
Over them will be fire closed in.

How to read it
rows: Idgham with ghunnah: tanween into م

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Balad 90:15-20 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 90:15-20 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: «نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ» (90:20): the tanween before م is ...
Listening rota: today's group recites 90:15-20 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite all of Al-Balad 90:1 to 20 to a partner. Partner ticks each ayah.
questions.a: Twenty ticks; slips noted for revision.

questions.q: Explain the difference between 'companions of the right' and 'companions of the left' (90:18 to 19).
questions.a: The right are the believers who did good; the left are those who disbelieved in Allah's signs.

questions.q: Who are 'the companions of the right' (90:18)?
options: Those who believe and advise patience and mercy
questions.a: A) Those who believe and advise patience and mercy. 90:17 to 18 describe them: they believed and advised one another to patience and compassion.

questions.q: How many ayat are in Al-Balad?
Think again: The steep path includes feeding an orphan relative and a needy person (90:15 to 16). Who could your family help this week?
questions.a: A relative in need, a neighbour, a food bank: and we can advise each other to be patient and kind (90:17).
